overview_description.description:
Meesho operates as an online reselling platform that enables anyone to start a business without investment. Meesho connects manufacturers, wholesalers, and suppliers with resellers who use social media platforms like WhatsApp and Facebook to sell products to their network of friends and family.

The company was founded in 2015 by Vidit Aatrey and Sanjeev Barnwa and is headquartered in Bangalore, Karnataka.

press_references.value: A ₹127-crore cloud clash: What Meesho IPO DRHP says about its dispute with AWS

legal_proceedings.description: AWS initiated arbitration in New Delhi against Meesho alleging non-payment under a Feb 25, 2022 private pricing addendum, seeking ₹127.45 crore. Meesho disputes the invoices and has counterclaimed ₹86.49 crore citing service deficiencies and migration costs.

legal_proceedings.description: The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) initiated a regulatory proceeding against Meesho in Vijayawada for selling non-certified consumer products in violation of Quality Control Orders, resulting in the seizure of goods across 25 categories.
